name: Old Mutual Limited
summary: Old Mutual Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial solutions to retail and corporate customers in South Africa and rest of Africa. It operates through Old Mutual Life and Savings, Old Mutual Investments, Old Mutual Banking, Old Mutual Insure, Old Mutual Africa Regions, and Other Group Activities segments. The company offers risk, savings, investment, lending, and income products; simple financial solutions for low- to lower-middle income customers; financial advice and tailored investment for middle-income and high-net-worth individuals; and employee benefits and business solutions for SMEs.
